Application Data.NAME: Paws & Claws Pet Emporium
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Paws & Claws Pet Emporium operates as a retail pet store offering a wide range of pet supplies, including food, toys, and accessories. Additionally, we provide grooming services for pets in our facility, ensuring the use of industry-approved grooming products to maintain pet safety and well-being. Our grooming services include bathing, brushing, nail trimming, and ear cleaning, all conducted by trained staff. We do not sell live animals and focus solely on enhancing the lives of pets through quality products and services. Online sales are available through our secure website, where we prioritize customer data protection and comply with applicable cyber liability requirements.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 06/15/2023, Cause: Minor injury to a dog during grooming due to a slip, Amount: $1,500.00, Status: Closed.  \nLoss Date: 08/22/2023, Cause: Customer's accusation of data breach leading to identity theft, Amount: $3,500.00, Status: In Progress.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe, UL Class 350, Grade 1, fire and theft resistant.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing with monitored alarm systems and on-site surveillance cameras. Two trained watchpersons during operating hours for enhanced security.
